# Harden volatile temporary filesystems
tmpfs /tmp tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime,mode=1777 0 0
tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime,mode=1777 0 0
' >> /etc/fstab && tail -n 6 /etc/fstab

commands.command: systemctl daemon-reload && mount /tmp && mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime /dev/shm && printf 'live mounts updated\n'

printf '%s
' '-- mount state --'; findmnt -T /tmp -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS; findmnt -T /dev/shm -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS; printf '%s
' '-- directory modes --'; stat -c '%n %a %U:%G' /tmp /dev/shm; printf '%s
' '-- behavioral probes --'; for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do p="$d/hardening-probe"; printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 0
' > "$p"; chmod 4755 "$p"; "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s direct-exec-rc=%s setuid-mode=%s
' "$d" "$?" "$(stat -c %a "$p")"; rm -f "$p"; n="$d/hardening-null"; mknod "$n" c 1 3; dd if="$n" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s device-open-rc=%s
' "$d" "$?"; rm -f "$n"; done; printf '%s
' '-- fstab verification --'; findmnt --verify --verbose
